<thought>We need the precursors generated by applying retrosynthetic template 6889 to the target molecule. The product SMILES (without atom mapping) is “CC1=CC=C(C(=O)C(C)(C)C)C=C1”. Using the apply_template tool with this SMILES and template_id 6889 will give all possible precursor sets.</thought>
<action>apply_template</action>
<action_input>{"molecule_smiles": "CC1=CC=C(C(=O)C(C)(C)C)C=C1", "template_id": "6889"}</action_input>
